note: A drone frame looking down a forested valley: banks of backlit morning mist drifting through dense dark spruce, a slender pale forest track curving down the centre-right, misty ridges receding behind, no people, vehicles or buildings anywhere in the frame.
why: It delivers every clause of the brief at once - slender road curving through dense forest, mist in the valley, shafts of sun, deep desaturated greens graded dark and filmic, real sense of scale and stewardship - while keeping the lower two-thirds as one quiet near-black mass for the gold statistics to animate over.

note: A blasted-rock and board-formed concrete chamber under a raw timber soffit, its lower half a black steel grating floor in shadow, opening through a monumental three-panel blackened-steel window onto glaciated alpine peaks under a pale cold sky.
why: It delivers the brief's dark stone room and monumental window onto snow peaks with a cold blue exterior, and its near-black lower half, black flanks and dark upper band leave a huge quiet field for the italic quote to animate across.

note: A clean-shaven man in his late fifties, deeply lined face and collar turned up on a heavy dark knit coat, carved out of a pure black studio ground by a single hard side light, with the left third of the frame falling to empty black.
why: It is the brief almost line for line — low-key, single warm side light, near-black background, real film grain and a commissioned-portrait gravitas — and the large dead-black area on the left gives the clip-path reveal something quiet to slide across while the face stays clear of the crop edges.

note: A monumental circular hole punched through a black masonry wall, filling roughly three quarters of the frame with true black, opens onto a flat overcast sea and pale sky with two barely-visible ships on the horizon and a sliver of warm brick at the right edge.
why: It is the brief's monumental illuminated portal cut through a dark face, rendered in the house palette rather than a postcard one, and its vast unbroken black field gives the closing headline and masked form somewhere to sit while the slow rotate-and-scale has no structure to betray it.
